scripts.check:types: tsc -p tsconfig.simulation.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.build: npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:comments && vite build
scripts.build:browser-test: npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:comments && vite build --config vite.browser.config.ts --mode production
scripts.check:release: npm test && npm run build && npm run build:browser-test && npm run check:browser-builds
